decision: Do not extend small-M Q4 WMMA to R6/R8/R12/R16. No current public MTP route executes those shapes and retained physical C2/C4 economics remain far below true AR.

physical_c2_c4.interpretation: Acceptance is repaired; target operation cost remains binding, but these physical shapes are not a public Q4_K_M product route.

admission_rules.required: materially new representation/dataflow with >=1.15x operation-complete leaf speedup or >=0.5 ms/token projected saving on a current dispatch
admission_rules.observed: no R6/R8/R12/R16 current dispatch; public c2+ typed K0

next: Retain existing rows2/rows4 owners. Reopen only after a public physical c2/c4 route is production-qualified and a fresh profile names an R6/R8/R12/R16 owner.
correctness: No candidate implemented; production correctness remains unchanged.
